title: Review F8 single-step quality, performance and device exit evidence
requires: Access to every registered machine's durable candidate evidence and independent review
scope: Audit the entire new real-time profile against the original F8 user contract, including all additional device/fix/requalification leaves discovered during execution. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: All dependency cards and every current-candidate required kernel/device row are merged done with reviewable evidence; missing hardware, failed quality or missed performance budgets keep this gate open.
Verify one fixed 1/60 step, one shared dynamic index publication, no hidden time subdivision/catch-up, bounded algebraic work, interpolation and deliberate overload slow-motion.
Verify approved accuracy tradeoffs, honest capability/profile negotiation, no vendor-specific physical fork, candidate-consistent deployment hashes and complete sustained timings.
Review independent quality, installed SDK/Gallery and device coverage separately; add any discovered gaps as new dependencies before claiming/completing this review.
